scheme_name: Swami Vivekananda Single Girl Child Fellowship for Research in Social Sciences
description:
The Swami Vivekananda Single Girl Child Fellowship for Research in Social Sciences was launched by the Government of India in 2014. 

This fellowship aims to promote the education of single girl children in the field of social sciences. 

The initiative recognizes the challenges faced by single girl children in pursuing higher education and research. 

The fellowship is named after Swami Vivekananda, a prominent figure in Indian philosophy and social reform. 

The primary objective of this fellowship is to provide financial assistance to single girl children pursuing research in social sciences. 

The fellowship provides a monthly stipend of INR 25,000 for a period of up to two years. 

In addition to the monthly stipend, the fellowship also offers a contingency grant of INR 10,000 per annum. 

This grant can be utilized for research-related expenses such as books, travel, and other necessary materials. 

The fellowship is aimed at encouraging single girl children to pursue higher studies and contribute to research in social sciences. 

The target beneficiaries of this fellowship are single girl children who are enrolled in PhD programs in recognized universities. 

To be eligible for this fellowship, applicants must be single girl children. 

They must also be enrolled in a full-time PhD program in social sciences. 

The fellowship is open to candidates who are below the age of 30 years at the time of application. 

Applicants must have completed their postgraduate degree with a minimum of 55% marks from a recognized university. 

The application process for the fellowship is conducted online through the official website of the University Grants Commission (UGC). 

Candidates must fill out the application form and submit it along with the required documents. 

Required documents include proof of enrollment in a PhD program, proof of being a single girl child, and academic certificates. 

The application form must be submitted before the deadline specified by the UGC. 

The selection process involves the evaluation of applications based on academic merit and research proposals. 

The fellowship is awarded based on the recommendations of a selection committee constituted by the UGC. 

The fellowship is disbursed in monthly installments directly to the bank account of the selected candidates. 

The first installment is typically released after the completion of the verification process. 

The fellowship aims to support approximately 300 candidates each year. 

The UGC has allocated a budget of INR 10 crore for the implementation of this fellowship scheme. 

The fellowship is part of the broader initiative to empower women in India. 

It aligns with the government's commitment to promote gender equality in education and research. 

The fellowship also aims to enhance the representation of women in higher education and research fields. 

The UGC regularly reviews the fellowship scheme to assess its impact and effectiveness. 

Feedback from beneficiaries is taken into account for future improvements. 

The fellowship has been well-received since its inception, with many single girl children benefiting from it. 

The UGC encourages eligible candidates to apply and take advantage of this opportunity. 

The fellowship not only provides financial support but also aims to build a supportive community for single girl children. 

It fosters an environment where single girl children can thrive academically and professionally. 

The fellowship has contributed to increasing the number of women researchers in social sciences. 

It has also raised awareness about the importance of supporting single girl children in education. 

The UGC conducts awareness programs to inform potential beneficiaries about the fellowship. 

These programs are held in various universities and educational institutions across the country. 

The fellowship is a significant step towards bridging the gender gap in higher education. 

It empowers single girl children to pursue their academic aspirations without financial constraints. 

The fellowship's impact can be seen in the increased enrollment of women in PhD programs in social sciences. 

It encourages a culture of research and inquiry among young women in India. 

The fellowship also aims to contribute to the overall development of society by fostering educated women. 

Educated women are more likely to contribute positively to their communities and the nation. 

The UGC continues to promote this fellowship as part of its broader mission to enhance higher education in India. 

The fellowship is a testament to the government's commitment to women's empowerment. 

It serves as an inspiration for many single girl children to pursue their dreams. 

The UGC's efforts in implementing this fellowship reflect a progressive approach towards education. 

The fellowship is a model for similar initiatives aimed at supporting marginalized groups in education. 

The Swami Vivekananda Single Girl Child Fellowship for Research in Social Sciences is a vital scheme that addresses specific needs. 

It provides not only financial assistance but also recognition and encouragement for single girl children. 

The fellowship is a crucial investment in the future of women in India. 

It aligns with global efforts to promote gender equality in education and research. 

The UGC is committed to ensuring that this fellowship reaches its intended beneficiaries effectively. 

The fellowship is a significant contribution to the empowerment of women in the academic sphere. 

It has the potential to create a ripple effect in society by educating future generations. 

The fellowship is a clear indication of the government's recognition of the importance of women's education. 

It is an essential step towards creating a more equitable society. 

The fellowship continues to evolve and adapt to the needs of its beneficiaries. 

It remains a beacon of hope for many aspiring women researchers in India. 

The Swami Vivekananda Single Girl Child Fellowship for Research in Social Sciences is a landmark initiative that deserves recognition and support.
